composition: four discs in diagonal cluster over layered collage
description: Four SKILCRAFT-branded compact discs are mounted in formation on a grid-patterned surface layered with iridescent green plastic, black reflective material, and printed paper ephemera. White cutout shapes bearing circular apertures run horizontally across the lower register alongside newsprint clippings and red vertical borders.
title: Untitled (SKILCRAFT Disc Formation)
